title: A Gujarat port just broke its own fastest-ever record - by breaking it even faster
sources: Maritime Gateway - Deendayal Port Crosses 100 Million Tonnes of Cargo Throughput 51 Days Ahead of Schedule
Maritime Gateway - Deendayal Port Kandla Sets New National Record With 9.63 Lakh Tonnes Handled in a Day
caption:
A Gujarat port just broke its own fastest-ever record. By breaking it even faster than before.

Deendayal Port in Kandla, Gujarat, crossed 100 million tonnes of cargo for the financial year on October 6, 2026 - 51 days faster than it reached the same milestone the year before, which was itself the fastest ever at the time. Weeks earlier, the same port set a new all-India record, moving 9,63,951 metric tonnes of cargo in a single 24-hour period, surpassing its own previous national record of 9,03,904 tonnes set less than a month before.

A port that sets one record is having a good month. A port that keeps breaking its own records is building a different kind of capacity entirely.
